title: Add HTTP2 connection and session window sizes
description:
Adds the following generated HTTP2 filters:

* http2.calculated.connection.window_size.before: The sender's current window
  size (in bytes) for this connection (before sending)
* http2.calculated.connection.window_size.after: The sender's current window
  size (in bytes) for this connection (after sending)
* http2.calculated.stream.window_size.before: The sender's current window
  size (in bytes) for this stream (before sending)
* http2.calculated.stream.window_size.after: The sender's current window
  size (in bytes) for this stream (after sending)

This is useful to investigate bottlenecks on the connection and/or session
windows.

Signed-off-by: Kevin Grigorenko <kevin.grigorenko@us.ibm.com>
